title: 比较句型

examples.en: He is as tall as his father.
Tom is the tallest boy in his class.
examples.zh: 汤姆是班里最高的男孩。

guess.question: 想说“他不如我高”，下面哪一句是对的？

options.text: He is not as tall as me. / He is not so tall as me.
options.feedback: 对！同级比较的否定是 not as（so）… as，中间用原级。

options.text: He is not taller as me.
options.feedback: 不对——as…as 中间必须用原级 tall，不能用比较级。

options.text: He is not as tall so me.
options.feedback: 不对——后面的 as 不能换成 so，只能是 not as…as 或 not so…as。

rule.rule: 同级比较用 as + 原级 + as（否定为 not as / so … as）；两者比较用比较级 + than；三者及以上用 the + 最高级 + 范围；比较级前可加 much / a lot / even / a little 表示程度
rule.formula: ① as + 原级 + as：He is as tall as me.　② not as / so + 原级 + as　③ 比较级 + than　④ the + 最高级 + in / of + 范围　⑤ much / a lot / even / a little + 比较级

anchors.en: This book is much more interesting than that one.
anchors.zh: 这本书比那本有趣得多。

anchors.en: Shanghai is the biggest city in China.
anchors.zh: 上海是中国最大的城市。

trap.wrong: Tom is taller than any boy in his class.
trap.right: Tom is taller than any other boy in his class.
trap.why: Tom 自己也是班里的男孩，要把自己排除掉，加 other。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——同级 as…as、差级 than、最高级 the…in/of，比较级前还能加 much 强调。

check.stem: This book is ____ than that one. I like it much better.

options.distractor: 有 than 要用比较级
much 要放在 more 前面

check.explanation: much + more interesting（much 强调程度）。

options.distractor: in China 是范围，要用最高级
这里是全国范围比较，用最高级

check.explanation: the + 最高级 + in + 范围。

options.text: Tom is taller than any other boy in his class.
Tom is taller than any boy in his class.
options.distractor: Tom 也是男孩，等于跟自己比

options.text: Tom is taller than all the boys in his class.
Tom is taller than any boys in his class.
options.distractor: any 后接单数，且缺少 other

check.explanation: 同一范围内比较要加 other 排除自己。
